spec.name: Competitions 2027
spec.purpose: The 20 competition slots Aluzina enters in 2027, ordered by submission date with undated slots last: each slot carries its materials folder, the project entered and where it stands from slot to result.
layout: Tabs: DataTable of the slots | Calendar of the dated slots
Drawer: slot detail (KeyValue) + the form that fills in name, organiser, category, submission date, project and materials folder + status advance
logic: Sort: submissionDate ascending, rows without a date last, slot number as the tiebreak (docs/knowledge/competitions.md: "organized by submission date").
Every null field renders as "unknown"; the 20 slots are seeded empty and are filled in from the drawer form, never guessed.
Status advances one step along slot -> researching -> preparing -> ready -> submitted -> result; the result text itself is entered in the drawer.
The Calendar only shows slots that have a submission date; with none set it shows its empty state, which is the honest picture today.
The list keeps the six columns that fit at 1280 px (slot, competition, date, project, folder, status); organiser and category live in the drawer.

actions.label: Save competition details
actions.intent: set the submission date of slot {slot} to {date}

actions.label: Advance competition status
actions.intent: move competition slot {slot} to the next status

actions.label: Open materials folder
actions.intent: open the materials folder of competition slot {slot}
